title: Downfall
description:
Port of all 10 playable Slay the Spire 1 Downfall characters to Slay the Spire 2:

- The Hermit
- The Awakened One
- The Gremlins
- The Champ
- The Snecko
- The Slime Boss
- The Guardian
- The Hexaghost
- The Automaton
- The Collector

Includes their full card pools, relics, potions, custom mechanics, animations, and visuals.

Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: Fix Downfall.dll architecture to AnyCPU (ILOnly) for arm64 macOS compatibility.
